sentences.text: This petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceedings in C.C.No.5262/2023 pending on the file of II Addl.
Civil Judge
and JMFC, Court at Kalaburagi

arising out of Crime No.18/2023 registered by Kalaburagi Women Police Station, Kalaburagi and charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323 and 504 read with Section 149 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
02. Heard the arguments of learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1 - State.
The learned counsel for respondent No.2 remained absent.

The case of the prosecution is that based on the complaint filed by respondent No.2 on 10.07.2023, the police have registered FIR, alleging that respondent No.2 had married the accused No.1 on 12.12.2019.
At the time of marriage 15 tolas of gold and Rs.10 lakhs were given as dowry to accused No.1, as per the demand made by the accused.
Subsequently, she was residing in the house of accused No.1 at Chincholi very well for 07 months.
Thereafter, the accused persons started harassing the complainant physically and mentally, demanding additional dowry of 04 tolas gold and Rs.2 lakh cash.
Subsequently, on 08.06.2023, the accused allegedly have thrown her out of the house without providing food.
Therefore, her parents came and took her back to their house.
Accordingly, the complaint came to be lodged.
After the investigation the police have filed the charge-sheet, which is under challenged.
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent of the alleged offences.
The in-laws of the complainant i.e., the brother-in-law, sister-in-law and mother-in-law of the accused No.1 are not before this Court.
There are omnibus allegations.
There are no specific allegations against these petitioners.
They are residing separately from the accused No.1.

Therefore,
prayed to allow the petition.
05. The learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1 - State seriously opposed the petition.
06. Having heard the arguments and on perusal of the records, which reveals that the marriage of the accused No.1 and the respondent No.2 held on 12.12.2019.
It is alleged that as per the demand of dowry 15 tolas of gold and Rs.10 lakhs of cash was given.
Thereafter, they have looked after the complainant for 07 months.

Subsequently, they have started harassing her on 24.06.2020 onwards Parvati @ Paramma And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137419802/
3 without providing food.

sentences.text: They used to NC: 2024:KHC-K:5944 tell that she should eat only on the last after finishing meals or dinner by all the persons of the family, if any food is remains, then she should eat, otherwise she should be on the fasting.
They used to abusing her in filthy language.
They had demanded further 04 tolas of gold and Rs.2 lakhs cash as additional dowry.
They have said to be assaulted physically and mentally.
Hence, the complaint came to be filed.
07. Of course the accused Nos.4 and 5 are the wives of the accused Nos.2 and 3.
The accused No.3 is the brother of the accused No.1.
The accused No.2 - petitioner No.1 is the mother-in-law of the complainant.
Of course there is no specific allegation against the accused Nos.4 and 5 in respect of what is their role.
But the accused Nos.3 and 4 are the brothers of the accused No.1.
The accused No.3 is said to be a conductor.
There is no specific allegation against him, but there is omnibus allegation against all the accused Nos.3 to 6 is that they are all harassing her.
The petitioner No.1 - accused No.2 is the NC: 2024:KHC-K:5944 mother-in-law.
She was also residing with accused No.1.
The father of the accused No.1 is not the accused.
All the allegations are omni bus allegations that all together are not allowed her to take the food, except there is no specific allegation against the accused Nos.3 to 6.

Therefore, I am of the view that continuing the proceeding against the accused Nos.3 to 6, nothing but abuse of process of law, in view of the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Kahkashan Kausar Alians Sonam and others vs. State of Bihar and others,
reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599.
